proves.claim: Main changing an unrelated hunk of the companion's file still composes, with no coordinator step.

items.way.unrelated-hunk-composes.why: An unrelated main edit to a companion's file blocked a clean merge.

proves.claim: A true overlap is refused, naming the conflicting file and hunk.

items.way.true-overlap-refused.why: A real overlap merged silently or without naming the file and hunk.

proves.claim: Matching deletions are clean when another companion change remains.

items.way.matching-deletions-clean.why: Both sides deleting the same lines was reported as a conflict.

proves.claim: An executable-bit change survives an unrelated content merge.

items.way.exec-bit-survives.why: A merge dropped an executable-bit change.

proves.claim: Src/item-folder-identity.js is gone and no tracked file imports it.

items.claim.folder-identity-gone.why: A retired item-folder module lingered and was imported.

proves.claim: The cells plan check and the cells edges check pass.

items.claim.plan-and-edges-pass.why: A claim change broke the cells plan or edges check.

proves.claim: An omitted session capture refuses before creating or reading the local ledger.

items.parent.omitted-capture-refuses.why: A missing session capture read the local ledger anyway.

proves.claim: An allowance of 15 percent left returns one 20-percent line naming the seat, percent left and reset time.

items.blocks.allowance-20-percent-line.why: Without it, a seat about to run out of allowance would show nothing in Needs you.

proves.claim: An allowance of 4 percent left returns the 5-percent line only, and 40 percent or an unknown allowance returns none.

items.blocks.allowance-5-percent-line.why: Without it, a seat about to run out of allowance would show nothing in Needs you.

proves.claim: The Needs you list composer shows the allowance line, and none without an allowance.

items.blocks.needs-you-carries-allowance.why: Without it, a seat about to run out of allowance would show nothing in Needs you.

proves.claim: A captured session retains its recorded self-review refusal and an unrelated positive.

items.parent.captured-keeps-refusal.why: A captured session lost its self-review refusal.

proves.claim: Review.independence off lets a session that built the item verify, session keeps the refusal.

items.parent.independence-off.why: With review.independence off the session refusal went missing.

proves.claim: A decision hand-off returns one matching answer to its source board, once.

items.decision.handoff-once.why: A decision hand-off answered its source board twice.

proves.claim: A handoff whose source lacks the newest trunk commit still passes placement.

items.criterion.handoff-passes-placement.why: A hand-off lacking the newest trunk commit failed placement.

proves.claim: An infrastructure Git read stopping the queued gate is never returned to the builder as red.

items.criterion.infra-read-not-red.why: A Git infrastructure read stopped the gate and came back as the builder's red.

proves.claim: The retry, the auto path and the head read share one memoized HEAD and tree answer.

items.submit-revs.shared-memo.why: Submit paths each re-read HEAD and the tree.

proves.claim: A submit-side HEAD read never asks for HEAD^, the first-parent log or the trunk config.

items.submit-revs.no-parent-reads.why: A submit-side HEAD read asked for HEAD^ and the trunk config.

proves.claim: The items front door loads and exports its API.

items.front-door.loads.why: The items front door failed to load because of an import cycle.

proves.claim: Item patches compose immutable retry-identical commits without touching the live index.

items.patch.compose-immutable.why: Composing a patch touched the live index or changed on retry.

proves.claim: Item patch tampering, stale binding, conflicts and unsafe paths fail closed.

items.patch.fail-closed.why: A tampered or stale patch composed instead of failing closed.

proves.claim: A clean retry composition preserves original patch binding and current trunk parent.

items.patch.retry-keeps-binding.why: A clean retry lost its original patch binding.

proves.claim: seatFamily plans no board_meta scan and 1,000 calls finish under 50 ms on 300,000 rows.

items.declaration.seat-family-indexed.why: seatFamily scanned board_meta and slowed on a large board.

proves.claim: Synthetic historical inputs: bulk family reads preserve requested-seat ties, shared sessions and ghost peer evidence.

items.declaration.bulk-requested-ties.why: Bulk family reads lost requested-seat ties and ghost peer evidence.

proves.claim: Synthetic historical inputs: blank requested seats retain row-ordered ghost peer LAST ties.

items.declaration.bulk-blank-last-ties.why: Blank requested seats lost their row-ordered ghost peer ties.

proves.claim: Synthetic historical inputs: case-variant metadata remains a peer but never overrides an original session.

items.declaration.bulk-case-variants.why: A case-variant peer overrode an original session.

proves.claim: Synthetic historical inputs: bulk family reads retain earliest nonblank declarations and exact historical receipt binding.

items.declaration.bulk-earliest-nonblank.why: Bulk reads lost the earliest declaration or the receipt binding.

proves.claim: Synthetic historical inputs: bulk family snapshots end at return and never cache a late declaration or rolled-back row.

items.declaration.bulk-snapshot-ends.why: A snapshot cached a late declaration or a rolled-back row.

proves.claim: Synthetic historical inputs: bulk family snapshots observe external writes and preserve preengine and inserting semantics.

items.declaration.bulk-external-writes.why: A snapshot missed external writes or changed preengine semantics.

proves.claim: Synthetic historical inputs: bulk family reads use bounded SQLite scans even when every seat shares a session.

items.declaration.bulk-bounded-scans.why: Bulk reads scanned unboundedly when every seat shared a session.

proves.claim: Inbox, status and heartbeat on a board with 1,900 agent rows spend under 100 ms in seatRecords.

items.declaration.seat-records-budget.why: seatRecords became slow on a board with many agent rows.

proves.claim: An item with a check, a brief, 3 tagged clauses and 3 files routes light.

items.shape-route.light.why: A small, well-specified item was routed to a strong reviewer.

proves.claim: No check, no brief, a fourth tagged clause or a fourth file routes strong.

items.shape-route.strong.why: A larger or vaguer item was routed light.

proves.claim: Criterion scope deduplicates files and maps legacy paths to their actual cells.

items.size.criterion-scope.why: Legacy paths or duplicate files inflated the cell count.

proves.claim: Real one-cell criteria do not turn surrounding prose into extra cells.

items.size.one-cell-prose.why: Surrounding prose counted as extra cells.

proves.claim: A board with a recorded patch objection replays it, and the projected lifecycle counts one patch-objected.

items.paths.patch-objection-replay.why: A recorded patch objection was not replayed into the lifecycle.

proves.claim: A board without an objection projects no patch-objected move.

items.paths.no-objection-no-move.why: A board with no objection projected a patch-objected move.

proves.claim: A submit lease renewal is not a re-claim.

items.lifecycle.renewal-not-reclaim.why: A submit lease renewal counted as a re-claim.

proves.claim: splitRecent keeps open and recent items whole and counts older finished ones by status.

items.hot-split.keeps-recent.why: splitRecent dropped open or recent items.

proves.claim: The counts plus the kept items equal the full item list size.

items.hot-split.counts-add-up.why: Counts and kept items did not add up to the item list.

proves.claim: quietFiles keeps files under the threshold, counts an unrated file as quiet, and drops a file at or over it.

items.quiet.under-threshold.why: A file at the threshold counted as quiet, or an unrated file did not.

proves.claim: A head that is an ancestor of main but not its tip passes when the base is its parent.

items.composition.ancestor-parent-base.why: An ancestor head that was not main's tip was refused.

proves.claim: A head not on main still refuses MAIN_NOT_COMPOSED until it contains main.

items.composition.off-main-refuses.why: A head off main passed without containing main.

proves.claim: requirePlannedSource stays exported as a no-op that never refuses until #6370 deletes it.

items.no-plan.require-noop.why: requirePlannedSource refused although it is a no-op.

proves.claim: submitPreflight on a fixture without the cells plan passes with no CELLS_PLAN_UNPLACED refusal.

items.no-plan.preflight-passes.why: Submit refused CELLS_PLAN_UNPLACED on a fixture without a plan.

proves.claim: The callers the CLI children must change are named.

items.no-plan.callers-named.why: The callers that must change were not named.

proves.claim: A runner clone lacking the newest main commit reads it after one fetch, with no infrastructure error.

items.preflight.fetch-once.why: A runner clone missing the newest main commit failed instead of fetching.

proves.claim: A trunk commit no source can supply is an infrastructure retry, never a builder refusal.

items.preflight.infra-retry.why: An unsuppliable trunk commit became a builder refusal.

proves.claim: The sensitive list is the fixed boundaries plus exactly the plan-derived cell paths.

items.sensitive.fixed-plus-plan.why: The sensitive list drifted from the fixed boundaries plus plan cells.

proves.claim: Gate and landing cells are named by the committed plan, so a move cannot drop them.

items.sensitive.gate-landing-named.why: A move could drop the gate and landing cells from the list.

proves.claim: An outside change touching src/gate/ or src/landing/ is marked sensitive.

items.sensitive.outside-change-marked.why: A change to src/gate or src/landing was not marked sensitive.

proves.claim: every items-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

items.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: Every items-cell test file that reads files carries an input header naming the cells it reads.

items.inputs.readers-declare-cells.why: An items test read repo files without declaring its inputs.

proves.claim: No items-cell reader declares source-tree; a header names a cell, never the whole tree.

items.inputs.no-tree-header.why: A source-tree header made a test a reader of every cell.

proves.claim: A seat that declared codex and rejoins with only a new model reads codex from seatFamily and every family read.

items.declaration.model-only-rejoin-keep.why: A model-only rejoin lost the cached first declared family.

proves.claim: A same-session peer reads codex after the model-only rejoin and an undeclared seat reads unknown.

items.declaration.model-only-rejoin-peer.why: A model-only rejoin leaked or lost the family for peers.

proves.claim: A later different nonblank family for the seat still refuses with FAMILY_DECLARED.

items.declaration.model-only-rejoin-refu.why: A model-only rejoin made a declared family changeable.

proves.claim: Every MAIN_NOT_COMPOSED refusal says run pullboard submit again, since submit composes current main.

items.composition.submit-again-text.why: A refusal told builders to merge main by hand when a resubmit composes it.

proves.claim: Each MAIN_NOT_COMPOSED refusal still names the main commits and overlaps it names.

items.composition.names-commits-overlaps.why: Rewording a refusal dropped the commits or overlaps it named.

proves.claim: Order/path.js takes the engine numbers from the state light door, so the items route no longer reaches the state machine.

items.logic-order-path.engine-numbers-fr.why: Order/path.js imported the state barrel, which loads the state machine at startup.

proves.claim: Vendors.js names no vendor environment variable and never reads process.env.

items.no-vendor-env.vendors-hold-no-env-.why: A vendor environment-variable list in the items cell made the core name vendors.

proves.claim: itemsFailedOn returns each item whose latest red gate failures include the red file and case

items.main-red-notify.names-items-failed.why: A fixed Main red must tell only the items it blocked, so a wrong match would notify the wrong items or none.

proves.claim: itemsFailedOn returns no item whose failures name another file or case

items.main-red-notify.skips-other-files-.why: A fixed Main red must tell only the items it blocked, so a wrong match would notify the wrong items or none.

proves.claim: A leased quiet file is shared by a second claim and a leased busy file still refuses FILE_LEASED.

items.lease.quiet-files-shared.why: Every shared file refused a neighbour even when it never conflicted.

proves.claim: newBlock returns the name, ids and tier for two or more distinct ids and a known tier.

items.block.new-block-returns-record.why: A block record with a repeated id or unknown tier would reach the stored record.

proves.claim: newBlock refuses USAGE for a blank name, fewer than two ids, a repeated id and an unknown tier.

items.block.new-block-refuses-usage.why: A malformed block must fail before any record is written.

proves.claim: clause 1: needsJudgement lists each wall or decision item with its reason, latest refusal text and attempt count, and omits abandoned, rework and blocked items.

items.needs-judgement.lists-wall-and-dec.why: Without it, the needs-judgement list could bury the few items a person must rule on under ones that need no ruling.

proves.claim: A foreign wait whose announced state is withdrawn yields a hold reason naming repo#id and the withdrawal.

items.cross-repo.withdrawn-hold.why: A withdrawn foreign item blocked silently with no reason.

proves.claim: An open foreign wait still blocks without a hold.

items.cross-repo.open-still-blocks.why: An open foreign wait was given a withdrawal hold or stopped blocking.

proves.claim: An unavailable foreign state names its cause: no link, revoked or no state yet.

items.logic-cross-repo.unavailable-names.why: Without it a blocked foreign wait shows no reason.

proves.claim: A verified or open foreign state carries no cause field.

items.logic-cross-repo.verified-state-ha.why: Without it a resolved wait could show a stale cause.

proves.claim: foreignBlockers returns every non-verified ref and drops a verified one.

items.logic-cross-repo.blockers-keep-eve.why: Without it adding a cause could change which refs block.

proves.claim: reofferDue is false before 20 minutes, true from 20 minutes on, and false when returnedAt is missing.

items.reoffer.twenty-minutes.why: A returned rejection was offered again too early or never.

proves.claim: largestDisjointWave returns the ids of the largest set of candidates whose files share no path, even where first-fit finds fewer.

items.logic-wave.the-best-set-beats-firs.why: Without it, a wave picked first-fit could leave ready items waiting that the best set would run together.

proves.claim: largestDisjointWave returns the same ids in the same order for the same input, keeping the earlier candidates on a tie.

items.logic-wave.the-same-input-gives-th.why: Without it, two reads of one queue could pick different waves.

proves.claim: A candidate with no files is in every returned set.

items.logic-wave.a-candidate-with-no-fil.why: Without it, an item that touches nothing could be held back by one that touches something.

proves.claim: stopFacts counts reject and reopen moves as rejections and TOO_LARGE, INELIGIBLE or BLOCKED releases as refusals, only after the latest criterion edit.

items.logic-stop-reason.facts-since-crit.why: Counts that ignored a reworded criterion kept sending a fixed item to the wall.

proves.claim: stopReason of stopFacts is decision, blocked or from counts, and thread text never changes it.

items.logic-stop-reason.reason-from-fact.why: A stop reason that read agent words could be chosen by the agent.
